text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours, with BTC showing slightly more weakness than ETH, though neither has broken materially lower. The Fear & Greed index sits at 27—deep in fear territory—and has ticked up only marginally over a week, suggesting sentiment remains depressed despite small stabilization attempts. Bitcoin dominance at 56.5% and $58B in daily volume indicate steady participation, but without conviction; the market is consolidating around lower prices rather than rallying into them.
